summary: CNB Financial Corporation filed a Form 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 announcing a routine quarterly cash dividend on its 7.125% Series A Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock and the related depositary shares. The board declared $17.8125 per Series A preferred share, equal to $0.4453125 per depositary share, each representing a 1/40th interest. The distribution is payable December 1, 2026, to holders of record as of the November 15, 2026 depositary shares record date. No special-situation event, advisory or structural mechanics apply; this is an ordinary dividend declaration for a $8.4 billion asset bank holding company.
